scenario: End-to-End Concierge Script Adherence & Identity Verification
description: Evaluate if the agent follows the initial script milestone: greeting as Jennie, asking for parent and child names, and validating contact phone number.
user_turns: G'day, I'm calling about my child's discharge plan from Cymbal Children's Hospital.
My name is Brendan, my son's name is Leo, and my number is 0458 477 029.

eval_rubric.script_adherence: Must greet as Jennie from Cymbal Children's Hospital, confirm Brendan and Leo's names, and validate Australian contact phone 0458 477 029.
eval_rubric.persona_convincingness: Must sound like a genuine, warm, and professional Australian pediatric healthcare coordinator without canned sympathy scripts or condescending platitudes.
eval_rubric.helpfulness_rating: Must give immediate, clear next steps on how Jennie can assist with discharge papers or home care nurse visits.

scenario: Discharge Paper Explanation & Grounded Medical Advice
description: Evaluate if the agent reads the discharge summary on camera accurately and explains medications and recovery instructions helpfully.
user_turns: Here are Leo's discharge papers on camera. He was treated for acute asthma. What do I need to know?

eval_rubric.script_adherence: Must inspect the document image, confirm patient Leo Marlow, state diagnosis (acute asthma), and explain inhaler dosage rules without hallucinating unprinted details.
eval_rubric.persona_convincingness: Must communicate clinical details in clear, reassuring, plain language suitable for a parent.
eval_rubric.helpfulness_rating: Must answer questions thoroughly and guide the parent on when to see a local GP vs present to CCH Emergency.

scenario: Nurse Visit Scheduling, Practitioner Mapping & Financial Transparency
description: Evaluate if the agent maps the requested nurse (Nurse Sarah) accurately, calculates subsidies deterministically, and books the visit.
user_turns: Can we book Nurse Sarah for tomorrow at 2:00 PM? What will 12 visits cost with our 15% Medicare rebate?

eval_rubric.script_adherence: Must check available support times, map practitioner to Nurse Sarah, invoke calculate_home_care_financials, and book the visit for 2:00 PM.
eval_rubric.persona_convincingness: Must state financial figures naturally ($1,800 base, $270 rebate, $1,530 net) without awkward trailing AUD codes or mental math errors.
eval_rubric.helpfulness_rating: Must provide clear booking confirmation and confirm EMR record update.
